December 16, 2024

# New `LocalizationExtensionKeys` value for Mexico

DateDecember 16, 2024

Version[2025-01](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-01)

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

As of version `2025-01` of the Admin GraphQL API, we're adding a new LocalizationExtensionsKey value to support the collection shipping credentials for cross-border shipments into Mexico: `SHIPPING_CREDENTIAL_MX`.

Learn more about `LocalizationExtensionKeys` on [Shopify.dev](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/enums/LocalizationExtensionKey).
